# PuntersEdge

> PuntersEdge provides probabilistic sports analytics for football, NBA, basketball, ice hockey and baseball. It is a platform under the Elite Workforce Impact Nigeria (E-WIN) Project Ecosystem. Sports predictions are uncertain; no pick guarantees a return.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Overview and data status.
- [Sports](/sports): Supported sports and dashboards.
- [Football](/football): Football fixtures and market analysis.
- [NBA](/nba): NBA fixtures and market analysis.
- [Basketball](/basketball): Basketball fixtures and market analysis.
- [Ice hockey](/hockey): Hockey fixtures and market analysis.
- [Baseball](/baseball): Baseball fixtures and market analysis.
- [Analysis board](/board): Cross-sport probability and price comparisons.
- [Value analysis](/value-bets): Model estimates compared with bookmaker prices.
- [Bookmakers](/bookmakers): Bookmaker margin and price comparisons.
- [Results](/results): Published predictions, settled verdicts and final scores.
- [Glossary](/glossary): Definitions of probability, expected value and stake sizing.

## Ecosystem and attribution
- [E-WIN Project](https://ewinproject.org): Parent ecosystem.
- [Omale Danjuma Ogale](https://omaledanjumaogale.ewinproject.org/): Founder & CEO.

## Freshness
Data badges distinguish live feeds from sample data. Feed timestamps identify freshness; source health and quotas are restricted to administrators. Provider quotas and outages can delay updates. Never describe sample fixtures as live.
